247 | // GetRepoPermissions gets repository permissions for a user
248 | func GetRepoPermissions(ctx *context.APIContext) {
249 | 	// swagger:operation GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/collaborators/{collaborator}/permission repository repoGetRepoPermissions
250 | 	// ---
251 | 	// summary: Get repository permissions for a user
252 | 	// produces:
253 | 	// - application/json
254 | 	// parameters:
255 | 	// - name: owner
256 | 	//   in: path
257 | 	//   description: owner of the repo
258 | 	//   type: string
259 | 	//   required: true
260 | 	// - name: repo
261 | 	//   in: path
262 | 	//   description: name of the repo
263 | 	//   type: string
264 | 	//   required: true
265 | 	// - name: collaborator
266 | 	//   in: path
267 | 	//   description: username of the collaborator whose permissions are to be obtained
268 | 	//   type: string
269 | 	//   required: true
270 | 	// responses:
271 | 	//   "200":
272 | 	//     "$ref": "#/responses/RepoCollaboratorPermission"
273 | 	//   "404":
274 | 	//     "$ref": "#/responses/notFound"
275 | 	//   "403":
276 | 	//     "$ref": "#/responses/forbidden"
277 | 
278 | 	collaboratorUsername := ctx.PathParam("collaborator")
279 | 	if !ctx.Doer.IsAdmin && !strings.EqualFold(ctx.Doer.LowerName, collaboratorUsername) && !ctx.IsUserRepoAdmin() {
280 | 		ctx.APIError(http.StatusForbidden, "Only admins can query all permissions, repo admins can query all repo permissions, collaborators can query only their own")
281 | 		return
282 | 	}
283 | 
284 | 	collaborator, err := user_model.GetUserByName(ctx, collaboratorUsername)
285 | 	if err != nil {
286 | 		if user_model.IsErrUserNotExist(err) {
287 | 			ctx.APIError(http.StatusNotFound, err.Error())
288 | 		} else {
289 | 			ctx.APIErrorInternal(err)
290 | 		}
291 | 		return
292 | 	}
293 | 
294 | 	permission, err := access_model.GetIndividualUserRepoPermission(ctx, ctx.Repo.Repository, collaborator)
295 | 	if err != nil {
296 | 		ctx.APIErrorInternal(err)
297 | 		return
298 | 	}
299 | 
300 | 	ctx.JSON(http.StatusOK, convert.ToUserAndPermission(ctx, collaborator, ctx.ContextUser, permission.AccessMode))
301 | }

28 | // Permission contains all the permissions related variables to a repository for a user
29 | type Permission struct {
30 | 	AccessMode perm_model.AccessMode
31 | 
32 | 	units     []*repo_model.RepoUnit
33 | 	unitsMode map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode
34 | 
35 | 	everyoneAccessMode  map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode // the unit's minimal access mode for every signed-in user
36 | 	anonymousAccessMode map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode // the unit's minimal access mode for anonymous (non-signed-in) user
37 | 
38 | 	orgRepoTeams []*organization.Team
39 | }
40 | 
41 | // IsOwner returns true if current user is the owner of repository.
42 | func (p *Permission) IsOwner() bool {
43 | 	return p.AccessMode >= perm_model.AccessModeOwner
44 | }
45 | 
46 | // IsAdmin returns true if current user has admin or higher access of repository.
47 | func (p *Permission) IsAdmin() bool {
48 | 	return p.AccessMode >= perm_model.AccessModeAdmin
49 | }
50 | 
51 | // HasAnyUnitAccess returns true if the user might have at least one access mode to any unit of this repository.
52 | // It doesn't count the "public(anonymous/everyone) access mode".
53 | // TODO: most calls to this function should be replaced with `HasAnyUnitAccessOrPublicAccess`
54 | func (p *Permission) HasAnyUnitAccess() bool {
55 | 	for _, v := range p.unitsMode {
56 | 		if v >= perm_model.AccessModeRead {
57 | 			return true
58 | 		}
59 | 	}
60 | 	return p.AccessMode >= perm_model.AccessModeRead
61 | }
62 | 
63 | func (p *Permission) HasAnyUnitPublicAccess() bool {
64 | 	for _, v := range p.anonymousAccessMode {
65 | 		if v >= perm_model.AccessModeRead {
66 | 			return true
67 | 		}
68 | 	}
69 | 	for _, v := range p.everyoneAccessMode {
70 | 		if v >= perm_model.AccessModeRead {
71 | 			return true
72 | 		}
73 | 	}
74 | 	return false
75 | }
76 | 
77 | func (p *Permission) HasAnyUnitAccessOrPublicAccess() bool {
78 | 	return p.HasAnyUnitPublicAccess() || p.HasAnyUnitAccess()
79 | }
80 | 
81 | // HasUnits returns true if the permission contains attached units
82 | func (p *Permission) HasUnits() bool {
83 | 	return len(p.units) > 0
84 | }
85 | 
86 | // GetFirstUnitRepoID returns the repo ID of the first unit, it is a fragile design and should NOT be used anymore
87 | // deprecated
88 | func (p *Permission) GetFirstUnitRepoID() int64 {
89 | 	if len(p.units) > 0 {
90 | 		return p.units[0].RepoID
91 | 	}
92 | 	return 0
93 | }
94 | 
95 | // UnitAccessMode returns current user access mode to the specify unit of the repository
96 | // It also considers "public (anonymous/everyone) access mode"
97 | func (p *Permission) UnitAccessMode(unitType unit.Type) perm_model.AccessMode {
98 | 	// if the units map contains the access mode, use it, but admin/owner mode could override it
99 | 	if m, ok := p.unitsMode[unitType]; ok {
100 | 		return util.Iif(p.AccessMode >= perm_model.AccessModeAdmin, p.AccessMode, m)
101 | 	}
102 | 	// if the units map does not contain the access mode, return the default access mode if the unit exists
103 | 	unitDefaultAccessMode := p.AccessMode
104 | 	unitDefaultAccessMode = max(unitDefaultAccessMode, p.anonymousAccessMode[unitType])
105 | 	unitDefaultAccessMode = max(unitDefaultAccessMode, p.everyoneAccessMode[unitType])
106 | 	hasUnit := slices.ContainsFunc(p.units, func(u *repo_model.RepoUnit) bool { return u.Type == unitType })
107 | 	return util.Iif(hasUnit, unitDefaultAccessMode, perm_model.AccessModeNone)
108 | }
109 | 
110 | func (p *Permission) SetUnitsWithDefaultAccessMode(units []*repo_model.RepoUnit, mode perm_model.AccessMode) {
111 | 	p.units = units
112 | 	p.unitsMode = make(map[unit.Type]perm_model.AccessMode)
113 | 	for _, u := range p.units {
114 | 		p.unitsMode[u.Type] = mode
115 | 	}
116 | }
117 | 
118 | // CanAccess returns true if user has mode access to the unit of the repository
119 | func (p *Permission) CanAccess(mode perm_model.AccessMode, unitType unit.Type) bool {
120 | 	return p.UnitAccessMode(unitType) >= mode
